title: Verified team-identity registry for pick origination
policy: An alias may join two provider names only when an official or first-party source link demonstrates they are the same team in the same competition, and every alias declares the exact competitions it applies to ('applies_to'). Sponsor/abbreviation spellings are not silently inferred and an alias never crosses into a competition it does not declare. Every alias below carries its evidence links and is displayed on the published page. Any name without a registry entry remains unmatched; missing values stay blank and are flagged.
updated_by: arena-2e8b83a7 research session (every alias carries its own official source links and an explicit competition scope)

evidence.detail: HLTV's own team page id 13683 carries the URL slug 'wrotberry' and displays the team name 'WBT'. HLTV is the official resolution source for the corresponding Polymarket match markets.

HLTV lists team 'WBT' (Ukraine) as the Group A participant in Elisa BreakOut Series 2, the same slot Hotspawn lists as 'WROTBERRY' with identical opponent pairings and start times (WBT/ENCE 12:00 UTC and WBT/BOJONG 16:00 UTC on 2026-10-15).
Liquipedia lists the Ukrainian roster under the name WROTBERRY with players svemyy/fl1peR/tired73, matching HLTV team 13683's published player records.
Liquipedia's organization page states: 'ROUNDS (formerly RoundsGG) is a Finnish esports organization' based in Tampere — the city hosting Elisa BreakOut Series 2.

HLTV lists team 'ROUNDS' (Finland) as the fourth Group B participant of Elisa BreakOut Series 2, with the exact Hotspawn 'RoundsGG' pairings and start times (HAVU 10:00, Phantom 14:00, Voca 16:00 UTC on 2026-10-16).
HLTV team 7865 is named 'HAVU' (Finland).

Thunderpick's 'HAVU Gaming vs ROUNDS' at 2026-10-16T10:00Z triangulates to HLTV 'HAVU vs ROUNDS' (match 2399425) and Hotspawn 'HAVU vs RoundsGG' (fixture 1080286) at the identical start time and opponent. Polymarket lists the same fixture as 'HAVU vs RoundsGG'.
HLTV team 13838 is named 'EAC' (Denmark).
Thunderpick's 'EA Copenhagen' rows share EAC's exact Elisa BreakOut Series 2 opponents and start times (vs WBT, vs BOJONG 14:00Z, vs ENCE 18:00Z on 2026-10-15).
HLTV team 13838 is named 'EAC' (Denmark).
Polymarket's Elisa BreakOut Series #2 fixtures use the long form 'Esport Academy Copenhagen' for the team Hotspawn and HLTV list as 'EAC', with identical opponents and start times.
